DPP NU Cup
Welcome to the DPP NU Cup, the second of this year's NU Classic Cups!​

As you may have heard, in 2026, the NU Classic is expanding into its own, fully fleshed out circuit. This will comprise eight cups - one for each old gen from RBY to SS. Players can earn points from their placements in each cup, as well as NU Classic Masters (ongoing) and NU Homefield (Early Sept), to earn one of 16 spots in the NU Classic Playoffs (Dec). More information on the new circuit can be found here.

Tournament Rules:
  • This is a standard DPP NU tournament.
  • Each round will be best-of-three. You may switch teams between games.
  • This tournament will be single-elimination.
  • All matches are to be played on Pokemon Showdown! Games should be played on SmogTours unless both parties agree to play on the main server.
  • Replays are required for all games.
  • Do not make baseless activity posts. As far as possible, all scheduling should be done in public on Smogon walls.
  • All standard Smogon rules apply. Everything can be found here.
DPP NU resources can be found here.
